description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for managing progressive, batched processing of items, particularly for expanding tree nodes in a UI context. It includes the core logic to process items in slices with time management, and a React hook wrapper for ease of use within React components.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, with support for progress updates, cancellation, and adaptive batch sizing.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the createProgressiveExpandController utility, managing UI state for the processing activity, including running state, progress percentage, and counts.

ctags.name: createProgressiveExpandController
ctags.signature: ({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })

ctags.signature: ({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
